$comment: The pin manifest. A build is in this repository iff a TRACKED file of Archipelago-CC names it; scripts/procgen/check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs in that repo gates the FOUR-way agreement between this manifest, the .gitignore whitelist, what git actually tracks here, and the build names that repo’s tracked files actually spell. Every build directory carries exactly four files. `js`/`wasm` are the AUTHORITY on the payload filenames — they do not always match the directory name. `capabilities` is the BUILD-SIDE HALF OF FEATURE DETECTION (⚖ user, 2026-08-29): the host decides from DATA whether a feature applies, never from an opt-in flag, so a build DECLARES what its ActionScript can do and the panel looks the entry up by the directory name its preset points at. It is MANDATORY and an empty array is a real answer — absence would be indistinguishable from “measured, none”. The vocabulary is declared ONCE, in the consumer (Archipelago-CC frontend/modules/flashPanel/seedlingRandomizerEligibility.js WASM_BUILD_CAPABILITIES), and check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs imports it rather than spelling a second copy, so a typo cannot pass as “this build does not have it”. ⚖⚖ THE MANIFEST-PROSE EXEMPTION (ruled by the user 2026-08-30, EDITOR INTEGRATION slice P4): a gitlink bump whose submodule diff touches ONLY this file AND whose per-build payload md5s are byte-identical owes the pins gate plus the bounded reach, NOT the full-tier drive — the md5 identity is QUOTED in the outer commit as the licence. It is written where the OWED gate reads (Archipelago-CC scripts/procgen/check-seedling-full-tier-owed.mjs, which is what prices the tier) and restated here because this is the file the edit claiming it is made in. ⛔ THE BOUNDARY IS THE PREMISE, and it is all three clauses: touch a build directory, an md5 field or the .gitignore whitelist in the same commit and the exemption does not apply — a payload that moved is a different game, which is exactly what only the full tier can see. ⛓ `summary`, `role` and `source` (SEEDLING ORIGINAL WASM slice W2, ⚖ user 2026-09-07) ARE THE README'S BUILD TABLE, and the table is GENERATED from them — Archipelago-CC scripts/procgen/seedling-wasm-readme.mjs --write writes the `GENERATED:seedling-wasm-builds` region of README.md, and check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs row (i) imports the same --check. `role` is one of demo / default, the vocabulary declared ONCE in scripts/procgen/seedlingWasmReadme.js, and ⛔ the row does not stop at the spelling: it asks whether the LABEL IS TRUE OF THAT TREE — `default` must be the build WASM_PAGE names, `demo` the entry declaring `demo: true`. (The `apitem-control` and `arm-control` roles retired with p4c and p4b on 2026-09-12, SEEDLING HEADLESS WEBGPU slice R2 — docs/history.md.) `source.commit` and `source.recompiler` are FULL 40-character SHAs because the table LINKS them: `builtFrom` abbreviated p4c's AS3 commit to seven characters and resolving it needed a clone of another repository. ⛔ THE PROSE FIELDS ARE NOT RENDERED — `builtFrom`, `namedBy` and `note` stay the long-form record and are read by people, not by the generator. The law itself now lives in docs/pin-policy.md; the retirements and the size policy in docs/history.md.

WHY: on headless SwiftShader the previous runtime (06f3d87d295b03b44b94221d38594612ecda4ff5) lost its WebGPU device at the first canvas present and then parked every other frame for 1000 × emscripten_sleep(1) ≈ 4.4 s — the "~0.5 ticks/s headless" this whole repo was built around — and its 283-layer bitmap texture array was over SwiftShader's 256 maxTextureArrayLayers, so the canvas was BLACK even when the device stayed alive. 254145a5b contains b0a6a487b (a lost device is survived: every WebGPU call becomes a valid no-op), c6681e744 (size-class bitmap pools), a39a8ab0c (per-class planning against the DEVICE's limits, spill into the next pool, and the `__swfGpu.texFail/texMsg/errors` readout) and its own fix (only Validation/OutOfMemory error-scope pops are counted, so a lost device no longer reports a bogus texFail). ⛓ MEASURED HERE, 40 s headless runs on the same box, this build against the one it replaces: with the Vulkan pair (--enable-features=Vulkan --use-vulkan=swiftshader) the canvas went from 1 distinct colour (black) to **44** — real pixels, the OverWorld1 room — and "WebGPU error" console lines from **3279 to 0**; WITHOUT the pair the device is still lost, `window.__swfGpu` reads **{lost:1, stalls:0}**, and the game keeps ticking at **26.4 frames/s** with no frame over 1 s (the previous build: 0.45 frames/s, period p95 4217 ms, 18 pageerrors). ⚠ THE RENDER SOURCES ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL AT 254145a5b AND AT master bdf734c46 (`git diff 254145a5b..master -- SWFModernRuntime/src/rendering/render_webgpu.c SWFModernRuntime/include/rendering/` is EMPTY) — the pin is about the recompiler and the AVM, which DID move over those 36 commits; it is not a claim that only the renderer changed. RECIPE, in order, identical to the 2026-08-28 one but with the recompiler rebuilt at 254145a5b in a git WORKTREE (~/CC/SWFRecomp-CC-r1, cmake Release, 83 s) so the primary clone stayed on master: (1) ~/CC/seedling_bot_build/build_bot.sh <out.swf> — Apache Flex ~/CC/flex-sdk/bin/mxmlc with the flags the 2026-08-28 entry lists (9.2 s → Seedling_bot_r1.swf 7d815662299c8b7027a69cb81e93bd4a, 7,750,572 B); (2) python3 ~/CC/flash-ap-api/inject.py <in> <out> → Seedling_bot_ap_r1.swf da451bfb4deecd5d16aad96b187b39d6, 9,743,894 B; (3) that SWF as test.swf beside p4d's own config.toml shape, then the WORKTREE's SWFRecomp/build/run-SWFRecomp.sh config.toml (the ulimit -v 4194304 wrapper, never the raw binary) — 4.8 s, 724 classes, 3917 methods, 3807 bodies, 0 verify failure(s), 504 SymbolClass bindings; (4) FRESH=1 SWFRecomp/scripts/build_wasm_avm2.sh seedling_bot_ap_p4d <recompiled dir> with the script's defaults ABC_OPT=-O1 RT_OPT=-O2 MOCK_DATE_TIME=981152406000 SWF_URL=file:///test.swf, emcc 5.0.0 (a7c5deabd7c88ba1c38ebe988112256775f944c6) — 90 TUs; (5) DEMO_SWF=<the injected SWF> deploy_wasm_avm2.sh seedling_bot_ap_p4d <recompiled dir>. ⚠ FRESH=1 WAS MANDATORY, NOT HYGIENE: WebGPURenderContext's layout changed in render_webgpu.h and the .o cache keys on MTIME, so an incremental link would have corrupted the context. ⚠ WALL 15m29s (START 2026-09-12T17:10:40Z, END 17:26:09Z). ⛔ A CONTROL BUILD RAN FIRST, at the SAME AS3 commit and the same toolchain, installed as a throwaway (seedling_bot_ap_r1ctl) and never committed: 15m29s, wasm e46265cf5b99b0c49abe76b1321ab290 / 33,971,938 B, and the full four-point verification passed on it before any claim was made about this one. ⛓ AND IT MEASURED WHAT “mxmlc is not reproducible” COSTS AT THIS SOURCE: the control's SWF is 50f0a857f40f233098f45e5b0bd088fc / 7,750,517 B against this build's 7,750,572 B — and after inject.py the two are EXACTLY the same length (9,743,894 B, same insert offset 9,734,163) while `cmp -l` counts **467,446 of 9,743,894 bytes differing**. The md5s here pin THIS artifact, not a function of the source. ⛓ CAPABILITIES RE-MEASURED AND UNCHANGED: `strings -n 3 <wasm> | grep -c '^arm$'` = 1 and `'^apitem$'` = 1, as before. ⛓ game.html and swf_bridge_avm2.js are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the build they replace (343aa2b2… / 9fbbf1bb…) — only the .js and the .wasm moved.

builds.note: Phase 4d — EDITOR INTEGRATION slice M1 (2026-08-28), and ⛔ NOT A DEFAULT: p4c still holds every SEEDLING_PAGE default, WASM_PAGE, the three presets' flash_panel.wasm and both tests that assert the name. Making p4d the default is a SEPARATE decision that moves 53 tracked files / 69 lines. It is the first build to carry anything the host reads beyond the vanilla item flags. ⛓ Pickups/APItem.as is built from an `<apitem tag= look=>` element the host writes into a delivered level set, GRANTS NOTHING, and calls Game.setPersistence(tag, false) on collection — `false`, the engine's own collected marker, because buildLevelPersistence fills the table with `true` meaning “nothing cleared”. Its sprite comes from a look → [PNG, frameW, frameH] table of sixteen RE-EMBEDDED graphics plus the shared Game.bossKeys[N]; re-embedded and not borrowed from a throwaway vanilla instance because Chest's own field initialiser calls Rng.cos() and would move the RNG stream every tape is recorded against. ⛓ `look == "ap"` binds a plain Image where every Seedling look binds a Spritemap, which is what makes the placeholder observable with no pixels at all: botMobiles reports `frame` as `graphic as Spritemap`, null for the logo and a number for a Seedling sprite. ⛓ The two seams are `<seq>|`-prefixed strings on the EXISTING BridgeGeneric channel — no bridge change, no re-injection change, no addCallback — declared BEFORE `level` in games/seedling.json, because BridgeGeneric builds its property list in declaration order and reports in it. ⚠ The seq prefix is load-bearing: a property is reported only when its value CHANGED, measured on p4c with an existing String static before a line of this was compiled. ⛔ FLAGS OFF IS BYTE-INERT: with no level set delivered and no external door, the only observable difference from p4c is the DECLARED property set — the four new properties present and empty/zero.

builds.note: ⚖ THE DEMO BUILD, AND THE REASON THE PIN LAW GREW A SECOND CLAUSE (⚖ user, 2026-09-07, ruling 4). Every other build here is pinned because a tracked file of Archipelago-CC NAMES it — an instrument drives it. Nothing drives this one and nothing should: it is the game a person plays, at https://peerinfinity.github.io/seedling-wasm/seedling_original/game.html . So it is admitted by the other reason — `demo: true` HERE plus a link to `seedling_original/game.html` in THIS repo's README — and check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs prints which reason admitted each build on every run. ⛔ THE README LINK IS THE LOAD-BEARING HALF: `demo: true` alone would be this manifest admitting itself. ⛓ `capabilities: []` IS A MEASUREMENT AND IT IS THE STRONGEST ONE IN THIS FILE. The vocabulary is `arm` and `apitem`, and both name ActionScript that only the FORK has: `arm` is the bot's world-swap arm time (fork branch `bot` @d4f1f37) and `apitem` is Archipelago's placement pickup (`ap-m1` @a0ec8642). This build is 826ba77 — the commit BEFORE the fork's first commit — so neither class exists in it, and `[]` is not "unmeasured", it is "this is the game before any of that". ⚠ It is therefore ALSO a second `arm`-less build, but row (g2) is deliberately NOT satisfied by it: (g2) asks for an `arm`-less build a tracked file can DRIVE, and nothing drives a demo. p4b remains the negative arm. ⛓ IT BOOTS WITH NO `__swfBridge` AND THE PAGE PROVES IT, MEASURED TWICE. Real-GPU Windows Chrome (intel/gen-9), the deployed game.html, one real click on the page's own ▶ Start: `__runtimeReady` at 0.5 s, 4,392 frames in 239.5 s (~18.3 fps), ⛔ 0 pageerrors, and exactly ONE console line naming the bridge — "[swfBridge] avm2 shim installed", the PAGE-side shim installing itself, with no `callback registered:` line after it (p4d's control run prints fifteen). The game's OWN trace() is the readiness signal rather than a harness timer: `Main.printItems()` prints "Level:" from `Main.begin()` at boot AND again from `Game.as:625` in the Game constructor, so the SECOND block — at 20.3 s — is the Splash ending and the playable world existing. The screenshot at 60 s is the title screen: "Seedling — press any key to play". ⚠ THE HEADLESS ARM CANNOT ANSWER THIS AND ITS RED IS NOT THIS BUILD'S: on WSL SwiftShader the same page reads 46 frames in 95 s (~0.5 fps, 36x slower, nowhere near the Splash's 450 frames) and 46 pageerrors of "A valid external Instance reference no longer exists", one per frame — and the CONTROL run of seedling_bot_ap_p4d, the shipped default, reads 46 frames and the SAME 46 pageerrors in the same window. A red the control shares is the rasteriser's, not the build's.
